title: Re:ZERO -Starting Life in Another World-
description: Re ZeroRezeroNOTE: Season 1 – The “Director’s Cut” of the first season has longer episodes, that are mostly two from the original combined into one. This alternate version also extends certain scenes, fixes a few censorship issues, and has everything (including the OVA) in chronological order.Natsuki Subaru, an ordinary high school student, is on his way home from the convenience store when he finds himself transported to another world. As he’s lost and confused in a new world where he doesn’t even know left from right, the only person to reach out to him was a beautiful girl with silver hair. Determined to repay her somehow for saving him from his own despair, Subaru agrees to help the girl find something she’s looking for.

Re:ZERO -Starting Life in Another World- Season 3 Episode 1
episodes_data.description: A year has passed since the battle at the Sanctuary, and Subaru has been spending fulfilling days united with Emilia's camp. However, his peaceful everyday life ends with the arrival of a single letter.

episodes_data.title: Re:ZERO -Starting Life in Another World- Season 3 Episode 2
episodes_data.description: Subaru desperately tries to fend off the attack from Sin Archbishop Sirius. But then, other Archbishops appear...

episodes_data.title: Re:ZERO -Starting Life in Another World- Season 3 Episode 3
episodes_data.description: After the incident in the main square, Priestella has fallen into chaos and Emilia has been kidnapped. Now it's up to Subaru and the others to rescue Emilia and the city.

episodes_data.description: The attack on the city hall enters its second phase. Subaru and Crusch breach the interior, but there they are awaited by Capella, who has some sneaky tricks up her sleeve...

episodes_data.title: Re:ZERO -Starting Life in Another World- Season 3 Episode 6
episodes_data.description: Bishop Regulus of the Seven Deadly Sins wants to force Emilia to marry him, even though he already has hundreds of wives. While he is having the wedding hall prepared, Subaru and the others are planning to rescue Emilia and reclaim the city...

episodes_data.title: Re:ZERO -Starting Life in Another World- Season 3 Episode 7
episodes_data.description: Through a Witch's Cultist's conference mirror, Emilia tells Al where the Sin Archbishops are and asks him to protect Beatrice. Al relays Emilia's message to Subaru, and the gang begins to devise a strategy to win back the control towers.
